name: TC-290: Restore All to Available appears only with out-of-stock items and restores the whole category
description: With nothing out of stock the category summary has no 'Restore All to Available' button. After 86'ing two items via the API the button appears; its ConsequenceDialog names the count and category; 'Restore all' → POST /menu/menu-groups/:id/reset-availability → '6 Available' and the button is gone.
